items.title: 21.5.1 Halogenoalkanes aur halogenoarenes ki reactivity ka muqabla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu comparison of halogenoalkanes and halogenoarenes (PDF 84-85).

blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes mein halogen alkyl group se jura hota hai. Carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity mukhtalif hone se halogen wale carbon par juzwi musbat charge hota aur woh electrophilic hota hai: nucleophiles us par hamla karte hain, jis se nucleophilic substitution reactions ka bara khandan banta hai, jab ke parosi hydrogen par base ka hamla elimination reactions deta hai.

Lekin halogenoarenes mein chlorine atom ka lone pair aromatic ring mein delocalised hota hai. Is se carbon-chlorine bond mein juzwi double bond ki khasiyat aati hai, jo use mazboot aur torne mein mushkil banati hai. Natija yeh ke halogenoarenes halogenoalkanes se kaheen kam reactive aur synthesis mein kam mufeed hain; maslan chloroethane aabi sodium hydroxide se hydrolyse hota hai lekin chlorobenzene aam halaat mein nahi.

blocks.alt: Chlorobenzene: chhe carbons ka halqa, paanch par H aur aik par Cl. Gulabi patti carbons ke halqe par hai, aur Cl ke gird gulabi hissa Cl wale carbon par us se mil jata (overlap) hai.
blocks.caption: Chlorobenzene mein chlorine ke lone pair ki delocalisation (kitab ke PDF safha 84 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gulabi patti benzene ring ke pi electrons hain aur Cl ke gird gulabi hissa us ka lone pair. Dono C-Cl wale carbon par mil jate hain, is liye lone pair ring mein phail (delocalise ho) jata hai. Is se C-Cl bond mein juzwi double bond ki khasiyat aati hai, woh mazboot ho jata hai aur mushkil se toot'ta hai.

blocks.prompt: Halogenoarene banane mein iron halide ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh Lewis acid catalyst hai: X2 se lone pair le kar use polarise karta aur electrophile X+ (aur [FeX4]-) banata hai, jo phir benzene ring par hamla karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Chlorobenzene aam halaat mein NaOH se react nahi karta lekin chloroethane karta hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Chlorobenzene mein Cl ka lone pair ring mein delocalised hai, is liye C-Cl bond mein juzwi double bond ki khasiyat aur woh mazboot hai; ring nucleophile ko dhakelta aur peeche se hamla rokta bhi hai. Chloroethane mein C-Cl aam polar bond hai jis par OH- hamla kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya chlorobenzene elimination kar sakta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Aam halaat mein nahi: C-Cl ke saath wale carbons aromatic ring ka hissa hain, is liye HCl hata kar naya double bond banana mustahkam ring ko bigar deta; mazboot C-Cl bond bhi aasani se nahi toot'ta.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat: DDT
blocks.text: Kuch halogen compounds, jaise DDT, keere maar dawaiyon ke taur par use hue, lekin mahol mein der tak rehne ki wajah se taraqqi yafta mulkon mein in ka istemal mehdood ya mamnoo kar diya gaya. DDT sasta aur machharon ke khilaf mo'assar hai, aur kuch taraqqi pazeer mulkon mein is ke hatne ke baad malaria se amwaat tezi se barhin. Kitab mahol ki hifazat ke liye is ka istemal mehdood karne ka mashwara deti hai.

items: Halogenoalkanes: polar C-X, delta+ carbon, substitution aur elimination.
Halogenoarenes: Cl ka lone pair delocalised, mazboot C-Cl, bohat kam reactive.
Chloroethane NaOH se react karta; chlorobenzene aam halaat mein nahi.
